title: Demographic Targeting Resolution
description: Lossless package readback for demographic targeting. requested preserves canonical buyer intent; applied states the canonical predicate actually booked; execution identifies the seller mechanism. equivalent is true only when requested and applied denote exactly the same set. Buyers SHOULD recompute equivalence from the two predicates. Sellers MUST NOT confirm a non-equivalent package without explicit buyer approval of the applied alternative, and MUST never silently broaden targeting.

requested.description: Canonical demographic predicate requested by the buyer.

applied.description: Canonical demographic predicate actually applied by the seller.

equivalent.description: Whether requested and applied are exactly equal, including unknown-age membership. This is derived readback, not permission to omit either predicate.

difference_reason.description: Human-readable explanation when equivalent is false. Omission is allowed only when equivalent is true.

buyer_approved.description: Whether the buyer explicitly approved a non-equivalent applied alternative before booking. Required and true when equivalent is false; omitted for exact resolutions.

interval_ids.description: Seller-scoped interval identifiers whose union produced applied.

signal_refs.description: Authoritative signal references whose demographic predicates were unioned to produce applied. Signal names alone never establish equivalence.
